answers.in-scope-brainrocket-en:
Ivan is a **Senior Markup Developer | UI Engineer** at BrainRocket, working on interfaces for iGaming platforms.

He builds responsive interfaces and reusable components, reviews code, investigates UI and performance issues, and mentors and onboards developers. He also takes part in the delivery cycle from design through release.
answers.in-scope-stack-en:
Ivan’s technologies include:

- **Frontend:** HTML, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Redux, TanStack Query and Tailwind CSS.
- **AI engineering:** Python, LangChain, LangGraph, Hugging Face, vector databases and OpenAI and Anthropic APIs.
- **Tools:** Git, GitHub, GitLab, Figma and Claude Code.

He has completed an AI Engineer course, and this website is his first applied AI project.
answers.in-scope-numbersvalidator-en:
NumbersValidator is a production web service Ivan built at Liketelecom to clean, validate and convert phone numbers. It can detect details such as number type and operator, and process individual numbers or batches from Excel files.

Ivan built it using JavaScript, google-libphonenumber, Webpack, Express and PHP. The [repository is on GitHub](https://github.com/IvanVasiunin/NumbersValidator).
answers.in-scope-rag-en:
The site’s RAG assistant, Elio, answers questions about Ivan using a knowledge base of CV entries, experience notes, personal facts, GitHub material and site documentation.

It uses **PostgreSQL with pgvector** for hybrid retrieval: vector search and PostgreSQL full-text search are combined using reciprocal rank fusion. The stack includes FastAPI, LangChain, LangGraph and LLM APIs; answers are streamed, with a live map showing the sources used.
answers.in-scope-liketelecom-en: Ivan worked at Liketelecom full-time from June 2016 to October 2024, about **8 years and 4 months**.

answers.in-scope-tanstack-uk:
У **навчальному проєкті** з курсу React Іван використовував TanStack Query для роботи зі станом даних сервера:

- `useQuery` зі структурованими ключами запитів, `enabled` для очікування введення та `staleTime`.
- Скасування запитів через передачу `signal` до `fetch`.
- `useMutation` та `invalidateQueries` після створення, редагування або видалення події.

Він також написав варіант оптимістичного оновлення з відкатом у разі помилки, але залишив його закоментованим. [Проєкт на GitHub](https://github.com/IvanVasiunin/events-app-with-tanstack-query).
